1.
None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.

2. This criminal revision under Section 401 read with Section 397 Cr.P.C. has been filed aggrieved by judgment and order dated 09.05.1997 passed by Sri Nawal Singh, Special Judge, E.C. Act/
Additional Sessions Judge, Etawah, dismissing Appeal No.83 of 1993 arising out of order of Sri O.P.
Dwivedi, Chief Judicial Magistrate, Etawah, convicting applicant under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentencing him for one year rigorous rigorous imprisonment and fine of Rs.2000/-.
